pages.text: Place the Stirling Generator beside the Alloy Smelter. Open each machine and install a Basic Capacitor in its capacitor slot. Set the touching generator face to Push and the touching smelter face to Pull using the side settings.

Put coal in the generator and watch the smelter fill with Forge Energy. Select the smelter mode that allows alloying. Use the powered smelter to make $(l:enderio:getting_started/conductive_alloy)Conductive Alloy$(/l).
